title: Aspire Nexi One BlueMint Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Aspire Nexi's BlueMint Tobacco prefilled pods combine the robust taste of tobacco with a refreshing minty finish, offering a crisp vaping experience. These 20mg nicotine salt pods provide a balanced throat hit along with a cooling sensation that enhances the tobacco flavour, making it ideal for those who enjoy a touch of freshness with their vape. Each pod contains 1.2ml of e-liquid and delivers up to 350 puffs. The 1.6ohm coil within these pods is optimized for mouth-to-lung vaping, ensuring a smooth and satisfying draw with every puff. The Aspire Nexi device perfectly complements these pods, facilitating a convenient and straightforward vaping session.
